apps.name: Tower
apps.subtitle: Unraid client
apps.localizedDescription: Native iOS Unraid server client. Monitors array health, Docker containers, VMs, and media services (Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Prowlarr, Overseerr, Tautulli) over Unraid's GraphQL API.
apps.versionDescription: Placeholder. Will be updated by the release-ipa workflow on first tag.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Tower connects to your Unraid server on your local network to show its status, such as array health and disk temperatures, and to start or stop Docker containers and virtual machines.
